---
title: "About PEExcel"
lang: en
---
PEExcel is an Excel-based tool for modelling and assessing positive-energy districts under the klimaaktiv framework. It is developed by the Climate-fit Buildings and Districts research group at FH Technikum Wien.

The tool is intended for professional energy and HVAC practitioners, competency partners, planners, researchers and students applying the PEQ standard to district models.

## Scope

PEExcel combines hourly operational modelling, scenario comparison and assessment of building, energy and mobility contributions. Model flexibility and declaration requirements are distinct: use the designated values and method when preparing a declaration.

The Excel workbook and detailed tutorials are in German. This English section provides translated technical guidance; ribbon names and worksheet labels are retained in German where they refer to the workbook interface.
